en: Oh! {player}, you found me here? I wonder what you take me for. Just a man who loves stones?
We fought side by side in Mossdeep's Space Center. You know what I can do.
If you mean to challenge me, then come at me with everything. I won't hold back!
Ever since we met in Granite Cave, I had a feeling you would become the Champion.
My hunches tend to come true. So where will you go from here?
...Ha! Even I can't see that far.
